extensions.note: EXAMPLE ONLY. This is documentation, not a deployed release. The filename begins with 'example', so src/lib/prepare.mjs validates this file and then discards it before any origin check: it can never produce a resource hint. The host example.invalid is reserved by RFC 2606 and never resolves. The sha256 values are placeholders and are deliberately not real digests. See README.md in this directory.
